scores.visual_critic_note: Muted Tableau palette with opacity-depth gradient and dark-teal bundles shows real intentionality, but the 900×900 SVG overflows the viewport in the default view (circle pack clips at the bottom), and the FPS counter plus easing-params section reads as exposed debug UI rather than finished product.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Force nodes use scaleSqrt correctly and data-driven domains with key functions throughout, but the sunburst applies a sqrt scale to the radial dimension (line 630) which compresses outer rings and distorts area encoding; pack and treemap layouts are area-honest via their respective D3 layout algorithms.
scores.stress_test_note: Easing param sliders fire updateLayout() on every input event launching a fresh 1500ms svg transition each tick; force-layout path morphing transition has no explicit .interrupt() before subsequent layout switches; hover and drag handlers carry no touch-event filtering, risking double-trigger on mobile.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Single-view architecture keeps working memory manageable and color-per-subtree (Tableau10, ~4 visible groups) is clear, but 300 simultaneously rendered edge bundles converge into a dense tangle at the circle pack center that is hard to parse at a glance, and the 200-node / 300-link flubber shape-morph across 8 layout modes is animation-heavy — perceptual quality of transitions cannot be evaluated from a static screenshot.
